svg.title: 01 | ZuCo 2.0 Expanded Source Audit
svg.desc: Observed NEMAR ZuCo 2.0 v1.0.0 source audit: 18 listed and selected participants, 18 NR and 18 TSR Run-1 recordings, 36 of 36 source packages downloaded, 3373.4 MB of source files, 128-channel EEG, nominal 500-Hz EEG and eye sampling, and recorded gaze StartTime offsets between -0.046 and +0.033 seconds. The uploaded split has 11 Train, 3 Validation and 4 Test people but was produced with an obsolete random split and changed five previously assessed six-person pilot assignments. Its participant roles are not approved and the corrected source notebook must be rerun before further alignment or modelling. Icons are schematic, not observed signal traces, and clock drift is not independently verified.

g.text: Recorded: 18 people | 36 NR/TSR runs | 3,373.4 MB | participant split needs correction

g.aria-label: Schematic EEG recording and left-eye gaze acquisition

g.text: Source files verified; five prior pilot roles changed under the uploaded split. Do not score Test.
18/18 paired-file complete, 36/36 run packages present; uploaded split violates pilot-role lock and must be rerun.
